events.description: Called with the text on each change.
events.name: onValueChange

events.description: Called with the trimmed text on send (the button, or Enter on web); an uncontrolled composer then clears.
events.name: onSubmit

events.description: Called by the button while `streaming`, to stop the reply.
events.name: onStop

props.description: The text, for a controlled composer; pair it with `onValueChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The starting text of an uncontrolled composer.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The run state: `ready` (the default), `submitted`, `streaming` or `error`. The text is locked while it runs.
props.name: status

props.description: The hint in the empty box. Defaults to the catalogue's "Ask anything…".
props.name: placeholder

props.description: The box's accessible name. Defaults to the catalogue's "Message input".
props.name: label

props.description: True to refuse typing and sending.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: The files attached so far, usually `AttachmentCard`s, drawn above the text.
props.name: attachments

props.description: The toolbar's start group, such as an attach button and a `ModelPicker`.
props.name: startActions

props.description: The toolbar's end group, before the send button, such as a `VoiceInput`.
props.name: endActions

props.description: A muted line under the composer, such as "Answers can be wrong; check important facts."
props.name: footer
